# 周易乾鑿度

**ID:** KR1a0166
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0163
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.7, p866
**Extent:** 2 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The fourth of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization. The *Zhōuyì Qián záo dù* is the *Qián*-hexagram half of the *Qián Kūn záo dù* ([KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163)) cycle and is preserved here in its independent two-juàn recension. The pairing of the two halves (*Qián záo dù* + *Kūn záo dù*) was conventional in the medieval transmission; the *Sìkù* preserves both as separate cataloged entries while noting their shared genre.

**Abstract**

The work is the *Qián* counterpart to the *Kūn záo dù* portion of [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163). As with the broader *Yì wěi* corpus, the substantive content concerns Hàn-period (or post-Hàn-but-medieval) divinatory-cosmographic apparatus; the Zhèng Xuán-commentary attribution is conventional and not secure.
